This area was once home to a sacred fountain dedicated to [[Dwayna]], whose statue now lies in pieces in the brush.}}

[[Druid's Overlook]] is the first oasis within the Maguuma Jungle from [[Kryta]]. It is home to the one of the few statues of the [[Gods of Tyria]] within the jungle.

==Getting there==
Completing the [[Divinity Coast]] mission is the easiest way to get here. Alternatively, you can head west from Kryta through [[Majesty's Rest]] and head to the central part of Sage Lands, in the higher elevated areas.
